grammar_title: 形式宾语 it(find / think / make / consider it + adj./n. + to do / that 从句)
source: 外研社选择性必修第二册 Unit 5 Using language:it as an empty object。句子地道、生态环境主题;真正的宾语(不定式 / that 从句)后置,it 预指,that/this/them 无所指,答案唯一。

points.point: 动词 + it + 形容词 + to do(find/think/feel/consider it hard to…)
points.overview: 当不定式作宾语、后面又跟形容词作宾补时,把不定式后移、用 it 作形式宾语顶在前面:find/think/feel/consider/make it + 形容词 + to do…。it 预指后面的不定式,that/this/them 没有所指。

points.point: 动词 + it + 形容词/名词 + that 从句(make it clear that…)
points.overview: 当 that 从句作宾语、后面又跟形容词或名词作宾补时,用 it 作形式宾语:make/find/think/consider it + clear/obvious/a pity + that…。it 预指后面的 that 从句。

points.point: make / consider it + 名词 + to do(consider it an honour to…)
points.overview: 当不定式作宾语、后面跟名词作宾补时,同样用 it 作形式宾语:make/consider/think it + a rule/an honour/a duty + to do…。若宾语只是普通名词、不是不定式或从句,则不用 it,因此能否用 it 取决于后面是否有后移的不定式 / 从句。

questions.stem: The rangers found ____ hard to remove every rabbit from the island.
questions.explanation: find it + 形容词 + to do;it 是形式宾语,真正的宾语是后面的不定式 to remove…;that/this/them 无所指。

questions.stem: Visitors think ____ surprising to see so many penguins in one place.
questions.explanation: think it surprising to do;it 预指不定式 to see…。

questions.stem: Experts felt ____ necessary to release a virus to control the rabbits.
questions.explanation: feel it necessary to do;it 是形式宾语,预指 to release…。

questions.stem: We consider ____ important to protect the birds' natural habitat.
questions.explanation: consider it important to do;it 预指后置不定式。

questions.stem: Scientists found ____ difficult to study the animals at such a high altitude.
questions.explanation: find it difficult to do;真正的宾语是 to study…,用 it 顶位。

questions.stem: The team thought ____ wiser to use traps rather than poison at first.
questions.explanation: think it + 形容词 + to do;it 预指不定式。

questions.stem: Tourists find ____ amazing to watch the elephant seals rest on the shore.
questions.explanation: find it amazing to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The villagers consider ____ rewarding to share their home with wild bees.
questions.explanation: consider it rewarding to do;it 预指 to share…。

questions.stem: Researchers found ____ impossible to save the parakeets in time.
questions.explanation: find it impossible to do;it 顶位,真正的宾语后移。

questions.stem: Many people think ____ unfair to blame only the cats for the disaster.
questions.explanation: think it unfair to do;it 预指不定式。

questions.stem: The guide made ____ easy for us to understand the food chain.
questions.explanation: make it easy (for sb) to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: Conservationists find ____ challenging to keep such a fragile world in balance.
questions.explanation: find it challenging to do;it 预指后置不定式。

questions.stem: We think ____ wonderful to visit a place so wild and natural.
questions.explanation: think it wonderful to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The crew found ____ tiring to search every corner of the rocky island.
questions.explanation: find it tiring to do;真正的宾语是 to search…。

questions.stem: Officials thought ____ urgent to act before more soil was washed away.
questions.explanation: think it urgent to do;it 预指不定式。

questions.stem: We find ____ encouraging to see the ecology slowly recover.
questions.explanation: find it encouraging to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The scientists felt ____ vital to record every change in the habitat.
questions.explanation: feel it vital to do;it 预指后置不定式。

questions.stem: Most people think ____ worthwhile to spend money on conservation.
questions.explanation: think it worthwhile to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The rangers found ____ useful to bring trained dogs onto the island.
questions.explanation: find it useful to do;真正的宾语后移,用 it 顶位。

questions.stem: Everyone found ____ shocking to learn that the parakeets had died out.
questions.explanation: find it shocking to do;it 预指不定式 to learn…。

questions.stem: The incident made ____ clear that the rabbit problem had to be solved.
questions.explanation: make it clear that…;it 是形式宾语,真正的宾语是后面的 that 从句。

questions.stem: Recent studies have made ____ obvious that human activity harmed the island.
questions.explanation: make it obvious that…;it 预指 that 从句。

questions.stem: The report made ____ plain that the cats were killing the native birds.
questions.explanation: make it plain that…;it 顶位,that 从句后移。

questions.stem: Scientists consider ____ likely that the rats arrived on the early ships.
questions.explanation: consider it likely that…;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: History makes ____ clear that one small change can upset a whole system.
questions.explanation: make it clear that…;it 预指 that 从句。

questions.stem: The new data made ____ evident that the bee population was falling fast.
questions.explanation: make it evident that…;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: We think ____ a pity that so many species have disappeared forever.
questions.explanation: think it a pity that…;it 预指后面的 that 从句,a pity 作宾补。

questions.stem: The guide made ____ clear that visitors must not feed the wild animals.
questions.explanation: make it clear that…;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: Experts find ____ worrying that the virus no longer stops the rabbits.
questions.explanation: find it worrying that…;it 预指 that 从句。

questions.stem: The film made ____ obvious that nature can recover if people help.
questions.explanation: make it obvious that…;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: Officials made ____ known that the island was at last free of pests.
questions.explanation: make it known that…;it 顶位,that 从句后移。

questions.stem: The story makes ____ clear that humans owe the island a happy ending.
questions.explanation: make it clear that…;it 预指后面的 that 从句。

questions.stem: Researchers consider ____ certain that warming will change many habitats.
questions.explanation: consider it certain that…;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The lecture made ____ plain that biodiversity keeps an ecosystem healthy.
questions.explanation: make it plain that…;it 预指 that 从句。

questions.stem: We feel ____ a shame that the parakeets were lost so quickly.
questions.explanation: feel it a shame that…;it 是形式宾语,a shame 作宾补。

questions.stem: The teacher made ____ clear that every species has its own role to play.
questions.explanation: make it clear that…;it 预指 that 从句。

questions.stem: New evidence makes ____ obvious that the rabbits caused the soil erosion.
questions.explanation: make it obvious that…;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The committee thought ____ important that local people join the project.
questions.explanation: think it important that…(虚拟语气);it 预指 that 从句。

questions.stem: The signs make ____ clear that this is a protected nature reserve.
questions.explanation: make it clear that…;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The success made ____ clear that careful planning can save a species.
questions.explanation: make it clear that…;it 预指后面的 that 从句。

questions.stem: The villagers consider ____ an honour to protect the wild forest bees.
questions.explanation: consider it an honour to do;it 是形式宾语,an honour 作宾补,真正的宾语是 to protect…。

questions.stem: The team made ____ a rule to check every trap each morning.
questions.explanation: make it a rule to do;it 预指后置不定式。

questions.stem: Scientists consider ____ their duty to study the endangered species.
questions.explanation: consider it one's duty to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: We think ____ a mistake to bring new animals onto a small island.
questions.explanation: think it a mistake to do;it 预指不定式。

questions.stem: The rangers made ____ a priority to remove the very last cats.
questions.explanation: make it a priority to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: Many people consider ____ a privilege to visit such a rare place.
questions.explanation: consider it a privilege to do;it 预指后置不定式。

questions.stem: The guide made ____ a point to explain the food chain clearly.
questions.explanation: make it a point to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: Conservationists consider ____ a challenge to keep the habitat safe.
questions.explanation: consider it a challenge to do;it 预指 to keep…。

questions.stem: The crew made ____ their goal to find every remaining rabbit.
questions.explanation: make it one's goal to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: Local people think ____ a joy to live so close to nature.
questions.explanation: think it a joy to do;it 预指后置不定式。

questions.stem: The government made ____ a law to ban hunting in the reserve.
questions.explanation: make it a law to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: Researchers consider ____ a success to bring the rare species back.
questions.explanation: consider it a success to do;it 预指 to bring…。

questions.stem: We consider ____ a responsibility to repair the damage we have caused.
questions.explanation: consider it a responsibility to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The school made ____ a tradition to plant young trees every spring.
questions.explanation: make it a tradition to do;it 预指后置不定式。

questions.stem: Visitors think ____ a treat to watch the penguins return each year.
questions.explanation: think it a treat to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The experts made ____ a habit to record the animals every week.
questions.explanation: make it a habit to do;it 预指 to record…。

questions.stem: The villagers consider ____ a blessing to share the forest with the bees.
questions.explanation: consider it a blessing to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The team made ____ their mission to give the island a happy ending.
questions.explanation: make it one's mission to do;it 预指后置不定式。

questions.stem: We think ____ a shame to waste such a delicate, beautiful world.
questions.explanation: think it a shame to do;it 是形式宾语。

questions.stem: The country made ____ a goal to protect its precious natural heritage.
questions.explanation: make it a goal to do;it 预指后面的不定式 to protect…。
